text:
Wireless emergency alerts
Emergency alert: Severe
This is a test alert from Department of Telecommunication, Government of India. 20-07-2023. 10:20 AM
notes: Genuine: PIB Fact Check says 'These alerts were sent under the Cell Broadcast Alert System testing' and 'do not indicate an actual emergency'. Hard negative: 'Emergency alert: Severe' wording from a real government sender. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
